boundary.description: From the point Bolton – Chorley District boundary departs from the railway, NE along that boundary to the point opposite Chorley New Road, Crown Lane, Lee Lane roundabout, and by a bee-line W to the junction of Squirrel Lane and Bolton Road (A673). By a bee-line through the middle of Lower and Upper Rivington Reservoir, crossing Horrobin Lane and Knowsley Lane , and through the middle of Anglezarke Reservoir to Fill Brook. N by that brook to and E along Warth Brook and Black Brook to Chorley – Blackburn District boundary. S by that boundary to and along Bolton – Blackburn boundary to the point it turns N near Lomax Wifes farm, and by a bee-line to the junction of Colliers Row Road and Smithills Dean Road. Then W by Colliers Row Road, Walker Fold Road and Chorley Old Road. Then by a bee-line S crossing Hight Rid Reservoir in the middle and excluding properties on Princess Road and the Kilphin to Chorley New Road. E along Chorley New Road, then S along Regent Road to and W along the footpath which goes along S boundary of the golf club and by a beeline excluding properties on Overdene Close and Morris Fold Drive, but including Morris Fold Farm, to the railway. W along the railway to the point it meets Bolton – Chorley District boundary (past Blackrod station).
